messages:
support_ash: Customer reported staging rollout 8f3c... shows "In progress" in Console for 3+ hours while logs indicate all canary tasks finished. Ticket #C-3421. They say embeddings jobs hit errors after seeing spinner.

maria_pd: Can you add repro steps and any screenshot / console logs? Is this only in staging? :eyes:

support_ash: Repro steps from customer:
1) Create canary rollout via UI (staging) -> route traffic 5%
2) Wait for health checks to report
3) Console stays on "In progress" but /api/rollouts/8f3c/status returns `completed`.

Screenshot: https://redwood.infra/sup/attachments/rollout-stuck.png

support_ash: Quick API check:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.staging.redwood.ai/v1/rollouts/8f3c/status
{ "id": "8f3c", "state": "completed", "completed_at": "2026-02-24T10:14:32Z" }
```
But the console UI still shows progress bar and a spinning health tile.

sre_tiger: I pulled logs from status-syncer in staging around that time. There's a flurry of 503s to control-plane and then the syncer didn't update the cache. Snippet:
```
2026-02-24T10:13:18Z ERROR status-syncer failed to POST /ctlplane/rollout/8f3c/status 503 service_unavailable
2026-02-24T10:13:18Z WARN retrying in 3s
2026-02-24T10:13:22Z ERROR sync loop aborted: heartbeat timeout exceeded
```
Looks like control-plane transient outage meant the syncer couldn't push status updates to the events index used by Console.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: status-syncer@staging v3.4.11 deployed at 2026-02-24T09:58:41Z :white_check_mark:

ben_runtime: We've seen this pattern when the in-memory cache and events index fall out of sync. UI relies on the events index for the per-tile inflight count. If the syncer fails to emit an event, the UI keeps the canary in "in progress" state even though the rollout completed. Short-term fix: force-resync or restart status-syncer pod to replay state from rollout-store.

maria_pd: Any suggestion for immediate customer-facing mitigation? We should update support with clear repro and ETA.

sre_tiger: Actions I ran:
- kubectl -n infra logs deployment/status-syncer | tail -n 50 -> saw the 503s
- kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/status-syncer
After restart, status-syncer reconciled and emitted events for 8f3c. Console refreshed and tile moved to "Succeeded" ~40s after pod came up.

sre_tiger: Command used:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/status-syncer
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=status-syncer -w
```

jessica_product: Long-term fix: add idempotent reconcile with checkpointing to replay missing events and a metrics counter for "status-syncer: last_emit_timestamp" so we alert before UI inconsistency. Also make Console fallback to polling the rollout state if events stream is stale > 60s.

ben_runtime: I'll open hotfix PR to add a small backoff + replay loop. PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4523 (hotfix/status-syncer-replay)

support_ash: Customer notified: "We identified a transient control-plane outage causing the status sync component to miss emitting the final canary event. We've restarted the syncer and your rollout now shows Succeeded. Engineering will ship a hotfix and add additional observability."

maria_pd: Please add a KB entry for support: steps to verify and restart status-syncer + links to logs. Also include UI workaround: use the Rollouts API to confirm state.

support_ash: Will do. Closing internal thread once PR lands and metrics are in place. :thumbsup:

sre_tiger: I'll leave an alert ticket: INC-7895 to trigger on status-syncer_emit_age > 60s. Follow-up owners: runtime team (ben_runtime) + sde oncall.

support_ash: Thanks all. Closing for now, will reopen if customer sees recurrence.
